newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-MARIJAMPOLE 5 MO SALES UP TO 75.3 MLN LTL.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-MARIJAMPOLE 5 MO SALES UP TO 75.3 MLN LTL.

text.p: Lithuania's Marijampole Canned Milk said on Thursday that its sales in the first five months rose to 75.3 million litas compared to 60.2 million litas in the same period in 1996.
The chief financial executive of the company, Terese Kirejeva, also told Reuters that the company was expecting profit figures for the first five months of the year on Monday.
The company reported earlier that its first quarter net profit was down to 2.03 million litas versus 4.5 million litas in the same period in 1996 despite a rise in sales.
The company is the biggest firm of its kind in the Baltics and exports around 90 percent of its products, mainly to CIS countries.
The current share capital of the company is 63.9 million litas and the state runs 66.5 percent of it.
The company said earlier it was mulling the idea of launching a 20 million litas share issue.
"We are working hard to find an investor and then intend to launch a new share issue," Kirejeva said.
The company posted a net profit of six million litas in 1996.
"We are planning that our net profit this year will be no less than last year but it is not an easy task," Kirejeva added.
Marijampole Tinned Milk moved to the A group list in April, increasing its profile on the Vilnius bourse.
